name: repo-agents
description: Four agents working the same repository concurrently with real searches, reads and test-suite runs (parallel strategy)

agents.instructions: Run the core test suite exactly once with shell_exec: `npx vitest run --project @joule/core`. Then report the number of test files and tests that passed, quoting the summary line. Do not run it a second time.

Run two suites with shell_exec, one at a time: first `npx vitest run --project benchmarks`, then `npx vitest run --project @joule/shared`. Report the pass counts for both, then answer. Do not repeat a suite.

Search the adaptive execution sources with shell_exec: `Select-String -Path packages/core/src/adaptive/*.ts -Pattern 'tool_wait' | Select-Object -First 10`. Then list that directory with `Get-ChildItem packages/core/src/adaptive -Name`. Report which files mention tool_wait.

Read packages/core/src/adaptive/lifecycle.ts with file_read, then check it compiles cleanly by running `npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck packages/core/src/adaptive/lifecycle.ts` with shell_exec (errors are expected and fine to report). Summarise what the file does in at most 5 bullet points.
